github._comment: Use a fine-grained PAT scoped to repo contents+PRs for dev work. Do NOT reuse the GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY here — that's for Aegis's own runtime PyGithub client, not this dev tool.

postgres._comment: Point at your local docker-compose postgres, not a Supabase/prod instance. Lets the agent inspect the repos/scans/findings/patches schema directly instead of guessing column names.

redis._comment: Inspect the RQ job queue backing pipeline/worker.py — see what's actually queued/stuck instead of guessing at worker state.

semgrep._comment: Official hosted Semgrep MCP. Lets the agent check rule syntax / run scans itself while editing scanner/semgrep_runner.py, instead of you round-tripping through the CLI to verify a rule works.

context7._comment: Version-correct docs for LangGraph, SQLAlchemy 2.0, PyGithub, FastAPI. High value here specifically because LangGraph's StateGraph API has changed across versions and Groq's SDK is young — training-data knowledge is likely stale.

playwright._comment: Drive aegis-frontend's dashboard, scan detail page, and SSE live feed for real end-to-end checks (Task 9 in your PRD) instead of manually clicking through.
